scope: Actual getDisplayMedia of an owned synthetic-English tab, production PCM worklet and SpeechController, native SpeechRecognition(audioTrack), rendered transcript. Not a live Meet, physical microphone, or one-hour tab-capture test.
playbackExplanation: Removed Playwright global mute because it silences capture too. The test overrides only suppressLocalAudioPlayback to true before starting the synthetic source. Production requests false to preserve meeting playback; that option is covered by unit tests.
finalGapCaveat: Interval between native final events, not speech completeness or end-to-end latency.
